gloss: vanity; showing off; keeping up appearances

definitions.gloss: vanity; showing off; putting on airs
definitions.explanation: The act of trying to appear better, wealthier, or more capable than one actually is.

examples.japanese: {見栄|みえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}って→張る：12583_haru⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought an expensive car to show off.

examples.english: I want to fix my habit of showing off.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {見栄|みえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧ (to show off, to put on airs)
- ⟦{見栄|みえ}っ{張|ぱ}り→見栄っ張り：20410_mieppari⟧ (noun / na-adjective: a show-off, a vain person)

TWO WORDS, ONE READING - {見栄|みえ} AND ⟦{見得|みえ}→見得：29012_mie⟧:
Both are read みえ, and the kabuki phrase is often miswritten with the kanji of this entry.
- {見栄|みえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧ - to put on airs (this entry)
- ⟦{見得|みえ}→見得：29012_mie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ - to strike a dramatic pose on stage, or by extension to make a bold public declaration
Note the different verbs as well: ⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧ for vanity, ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ for the pose.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{虚栄心|きょえいしん}→虚栄心：07291_kyoeishin⟧ (vanity, conceit) - the inner feeling, more abstract and more formal.
- {見栄|みえ} is the outward display: the car, the restaurant, the story told to impress.

USAGE:
{見栄|みえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧ usually implies spending beyond one's means or claiming more success than one has, and it is mildly critical - including when speakers apply it to themselves.
